ui.title: Player profile & progression
ui.description: A bold purple player profile with a clear level and XP hierarchy, player titles, and unlockable banners. A consistent visual language connects the profile overview and customization panels.

ui.title: Fantasy inventory & equipment
ui.description: A dark fantasy inventory built around readable item categories, an organized item grid, equipment slots, and a separate item details panel. Gold accents make the selected category and equipped item easy to identify.

ui.title: Colorful simulator HUD
ui.description: A playful simulator interface with distinct currency counters, a level progress bar, and recognizable shortcuts for the shop, pets, rebirths, and codes. Bright icon buttons keep the core actions easy to scan.

ui.title: Fantasy game navigation
ui.description: A coordinated fantasy HUD with a compact top navigation bar and prominent Shop, Play, and Classes actions. Dark panels, warm borders, and consistent icons give the interface a cohesive style.
